_read_me: Copy of this file lives at ~/Library/Application Support/whatsup/config.json. Keep it private: it holds your secret calendar addresses. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
_calendars_help: One entry per family calendar. ics_url = Google Calendar > Settings > (calendar) > Integrate calendar > 'Secret address in iCal format'. show_details=false shows every event as 'Busy'. Events marked Private in Google always show as 'Busy'.
_cameras_help: Only these streams can ever play. Use either youtube_video_id (the 11 characters after v= in the link) or youtube_channel_id (starts with UC). Leave both empty to hide a camera.
_rotate_help: In screensaver mode, switch to the next camera every N minutes (0 = always show the first one).
